description: This file defines the EntityNotFoundException class, which extends a custom exception class. It is used to signal that a requested entity was not found in the database within the context of a banking application.

classes.name: EntityNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating an entity was not found in the database.

methods.name: EntityNotFoundException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message and error code.

methods.name: EntityNotFoundException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom message to be specified for the exception.
